summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Cybin Inc., operating as Helus Pharma, announcing that its Interim CEO, Eric So, will speak on a panel at the 29th Annual Milken Institute Global Conference. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed. The filing is routine investor relations activity with no financial terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics. As a foreign private issuer report of a conference participation, it maps to a routine current report on Form 8-K. There are no deal terms or special situation triggers.
